layout_sources: https://github.com/milankni/ofxstatement-raiffeisencz/blob/HEAD/src/ofxstatement/plugins/raiffeisencz.py (UTF-8; semicolon; double quotes; one header row; columns by name: "Datum zaúčtování" as DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM, "Datum provedení" as DD.MM.YYYY, Zpráva, Název protiúčtu, Číslo protiúčtu, Zaúčtovaná částka, VS, KS, SS, Id transakce, Typ transakce, Poznámka, Poplatky; amounts with a comma decimal and possibly spaces for thousands)

https://github.com/bank2ynab/bank2ynab/blob/develop/bank2ynab/data/bank2ynab.conf [CZ Raiffeisen bank] (file Pohyby_<10 digits>_<12 digits>.csv or Movements_...; semicolon; first column a %d.%m.%Y date; the amount in the 14th column)
notes: Raiffeisenbank internet banking "Pohyby na účtu" CSV. UTF-8 without BOM, CRLF assumed, semicolon-separated, every field double-quoted. "Datum provedení" (DD.MM.YYYY) comes first and "Datum zaúčtování" (booking, DD.MM.YYYY HH:MM) second; "Zaúčtovaná částka" signed with a comma decimal and a space for thousands ("-13 500,00"); "Měna účtu" CZK; the original amount and currency in two columns both named "Původní částka a měna"; no balance. Newest first. The full 22-column order is from memory; the plugin confirms the names it uses and bank2ynab the positions of the date and amount. Expected dates are "Datum zaúčtování" (the booking; card lines are booked a day or two after they are made).
